main.description: A cheeseburger review. Authored and owned by the reviewer, stored on their own PDS. CBDB indexes these records; it does not own them.

restaurant.description: Official name of the restaurant, e.g. 'Tulip Shop Tavern'.

location.description: Human-readable city and region as written by the reviewer, e.g. 'Portland, OR'.

geo.description: Optional coordinates. Uses the shared community lexicon for ATGeo interoperability.

address.description: Optional structured address. Uses the shared community lexicon.

placeId.description: Optional. Canonical place identifier, e.g. a Foursquare Open Source Place ID ('FSQ:...'), used to cluster reviews of the same restaurant across reviewers.

rating.description: Editorial verdict. legendary = Legendary, trip = Worth A Trip, solid = Solid, skip = Skip It. Not averaged: one reviewer's judgment stands as written.

price.description: Price tier for the burger as paid on the visit. $ = under $11, $$ = $12-21, $$$ = $22 and up.

burger.description: The Burger. What's on it, what's made in-house, how it was cooked.

take.description: The Take. Why it earned the rating: value, sides, the visit.

bskyPost.description: Optional. AT-URI of a Bluesky post crossposted from this review. The review is canonical; the post is a share of it.

photo.description: Photo of the burger from that visit.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp of when the review was written.
